records.section: Runbook — word-bank review loop (thorough, Fable-performed) / The loop, per unit
records.requirementOrFinding: content wordbank # stage-2 drafts (already done for all 57) content review-doc --wordbank --unit g2-u03 → content/corpus/units/g2-u03/review/wordbank.review.md (full table + evidence flags) → state: wordbank_review [adversarial review — see protocol below: verdicts + cell edits go INTO the doc] content ingest-review --wordbank --unit g2-u03 [--dry-run] → cell diffs → content/overlays/parse-fixes.json (regenerable, guardrail 10) → drop/add → overlays + ids.lock (overlay: keys, tombstone-proof) → re-runs the grade's wordbank stage, verifies consequences landed → review/wordbank.flags.json + wordbank.reviewed.json (audit) → state: wordbank_approved (by: fable) | changes_requested content validate # V-A..V-E must stay green (CI enforces on the PR)
